name: Avatar
description: Subject: antd@5.29.3 (pinned, examples/antd/PROVENANCE.md). CURATED seed for the antd P2 exam (code→canvas, held out) — props/axes only; anatomy is promoted from captured DOM truth. Every axis value is the library's own declared enum (antd spells them as `readonly [...]` tuples; seed-gen reads them once its declaration lookup ignores directory case — W1, examples/antd/RECON.md §4). ATOM, SIZE×SHAPE (the MUI Avatar precedent plus antd's real size enum small|default|large → 24/32/40px). The text child is ONE glyph on purpose: antd's text-fit ResizeObserver writes an inline `transform: scale(n)` on span.ant-avatar-string (scale(1) for a single initial; a T3 dynamic channel if the initial overflowed). NAMED OUT: `icon` (child SWAP — replaces the string part), `src`, numeric `size`, `gap`.
